name: AudioMNIST: Spoken Digits Audio Classification Benchmark
description: AudioMNIST is an acoustic benchmark dataset comprising 30,000 audio recordings of spoken digits (0-9) spoken in English. Captured from 60 distinct human speakers of varying genders and accents (50 repetitions per digit per speaker), it serves as a lightweight, standardized speech recognition testbed tailored for neural audio architectures, explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), and acoustic feature visualization.
